resale_co.name: Certificate of Compliance for Residential Resale (Continued Certificate of Compliance)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Paramus Building Department (Construction Code Official), with the Fire Official or designee for smoke alarms
resale_co.lead_time: All open construction permits must be closed at least one week before the resale inspection is scheduled. Inspections are Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 12:00 pm.
requirements: All open construction permits closed out at least one week before scheduling
Zoning conformance and no clear-water discharge (sump, roof, yard drainage) into the public sewer (Borough Code §363-5G)
Smoke alarms on each level and near bedrooms; ten-year sealed battery alarms where hardwired were not required; hardwired alarms may not be replaced with battery units
Carbon monoxide detectors near all bedrooms and sleeping areas (UL 2034)
Secondary power source label (generator, solar, battery storage) within 18 inches of the main panel and meter
House address displayed; Borough-issued garbage and recycling containers on the property; pools fenced
Work done without permits must be permitted and inspected before the certificate is issued

fees.label: Certificate of Compliance for residential resale
fees.quote: an application may be submitted along with a fee of $100 for the sale of a home

fees.label: Certificate of compliance, inspection and issuance (Borough Code §197-3)
fees.quote: The applicant shall pay the sum of $100 to the Borough of Paramus to cover the administrative costs of inspections and issuance of the certificate of compliance.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Confirm with the Building Department that all prior permits are closed, then apply online through the SDL portal or fill out the PDF Residential Resale Application and submit it with the $100 fee. The Borough then calls to schedule the inspection. The certificate is emailed or picked up at the Building Department, One Jockish Square.

evidence.quote: An application for Certificate of Compliance is required for selling or renting a home in Paramus.
Sellers please note that this Certificate is mandatory for real estate closings.
Inspections are daily from 9:00 am – 12:00 pm.
The Inspector will confirm the location of smoke/carbon monoxide detectors and fire extinguisher.
All open construction permits MUST be closed out at least one week prior to scheduling the Resale/Tenancy of the home
Prior to the resale of all residential properties within the Borough of Paramus, a certificate of compliance from the Building Department shall be required.

resale_co.notes: Borough Code chapter 197 (Ord. No. 2024-04) was read through the ecode360 print view; Appendix §A460-14 repeats the $100 fee. The $300 'continued certificate of occupancy' in the same chapter applies to new commercial tenants, not home sales. Residential tenancy certificates ($100) and the lead-based paint inspection program for rentals are rental-only. The web page still says the inspector confirms a fire extinguisher, but the June 12, 2025 guidelines say fire extinguishers are no longer required, only recommended. Building Department hours 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

requirements: Smoke alarms located per NFPA 72, at least one on each level and in the immediate vicinity of all bedrooms
Hardwired alarms from original construction may not be replaced with battery units; elsewhere use ten-year sealed battery alarms (ANSI/UL 217)
Carbon monoxide detectors near all bedrooms and sleeping areas (UL 2034, NFPA 720)
If smoke alarms are tied to a burglar alarm, call the alarm company 15 minutes before the inspector arrives and know the reset code
Secondary power source label within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and meter
Fire extinguisher no longer required, only recommended (Borough guidelines revised 06/12/25)

authorities.name: Borough of Paramus Building Department with the Paramus Fire Prevention Bureau (smoke/CO check is part of the resale Certificate of Compliance)
authorities.lead_time: Inspections Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 12:00 pm, scheduled after the application and fee are received.

fees.label: Smoke/CO check within the resale Certificate of Compliance (same fee, not an extra charge)
fees.quote: an application may be submitted along with a fee of $100 for the sale of a home

authorities.how_to_apply: Included in the Residential Resale Certificate of Compliance application to the Building Department (SDL portal or PDF form).

evidence.quote: Also, the Fire Official or designee shall inspect property for conformance with New Jersey P.L. 1991, c. 92, Smoke-Sensitive Alarm Devices.
GUIDELINES FOR SMOKE ALARMS, CARBON MONOXIDE DETECTORS
Although no longer required Fire Extinguishers are recommended

LEAID: 0246-001 Paramus Boro SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name: Paramus Boro Fire Prev Enf Auth. Municipal Addr: 1 Jockish Sq ... Fire Official Daniel Perez Phone (201) 265-2100 ... Email dperez@paramusborough.org

fire_cert.notes: No separate smoke certificate fee was found; the Borough runs the smoke/CO inspection inside the $100 resale Certificate of Compliance. The DCA directory lists Daniel Perez as Fire Official at (201) 265-2100 (ext 622 appears in the listing). State law (P.L.2025, c.19, signed February 3, 2025) dropped the portable fire extinguisher from the state sale certificate. Paramus's own guidelines already reflect this.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: All open construction permits must be closed at least one week before the resale inspection; unpermitted work must be permitted and inspected first.

other_items.label: Clear-water discharge into sewer
other_items.detail: The resale inspection checks conformance with Borough Code §363-5 Subsection G, which bars discharging sump, roof, yard or groundwater into the public sewer.

other_items.label: Garbage and recycling containers
other_items.detail: Borough-issued containers with matching serial numbers must be on the property; missing ones must be bought at DPW before the inspection.

other_items.label: Secondary power source label
other_items.detail: Homes with generators, solar or battery storage need a permanent 'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER' type label near the panel and meter.
